title: chore(deps): upgrade @objectstack/{spec,formula,client} to ^12.2.0
body:
## Summary
- Bumps `@objectstack/spec` (^11.7.0 → ^12.2.0), `@objectstack/formula` (^11.5.0 → ^12.2.0), and `@objectstack/client` (^11.5.0 → ^12.2.0) across all 15 affected `package.json` files (root + `packages/*` + `apps/*`) and refreshes `pnpm-lock.yaml`.
- Reviewed the framework's `@objectstack/spec` CHANGELOG for v11.8–v12.2 breaking changes (retired `trigger`/`router`/`function`/`service` metadata kinds, `api.requireAuth` defaulting to `true`, nav-item `filters`/`recordId`/`viewName` exclusivity, `userFilters` rejected on object list views). None of these affect this repo:
  - `requireAuth` isn't referenced anywhere in this frontend codebase.
  - The retired metadata kinds are only referenced by a local, decoupled metadata-admin UI registry (string-keyed, not tied to spec's enum).
  - ObjectUI maintains its own local Zod schema mirrors (`packages/types/src/zod/*`) rather than importing spec's Zod validators for nav items / list views, so the tightened validation in spec doesn't change this repo's runtime behavior.
  - The only non-type-only runtime imports from `@objectstack/spec` are `DashboardSchema`, `ReportSchema`, `GanttConfigSchema`, and `deriveFieldGroupLayout` — none of which changed shape in this range.
  - `compactLayout` (removed in spec 11.10.0) was already migrated away in this repo prior to this change.

## Test plan
- [x] `pnpm install` — lockfile refreshed cleanly against the new version range
- [x] `pnpm type-check` (turbo, `--continue`) — 63/64 tasks pass; the one failure (`@object-ui/data-objectstack#type-check`) is a pre-existing, unrelated test-file type error present before this change
- [x] `pnpm test` (full vitest run) — 433 test files passed / 1 skipped, 5385 tests passed / 24 skipped, 0 failures
